pr_body:
Fixes #5093 

Adds the ability to `tab` while entering the repo name in the `cs create` command in order to get suggestions. Suggestions are populated from the `search/repositories` API.
pr_comments: Thanks @adonovan for the feedback and tips! It was very helpful 🎉

issue_context.title: Add repo suggestions for `gh cs create`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

When running `gh cs create` interactively you need to enter the full repo name with owner manually. Other clients offer suggestions once the user starts typing by using the search API, `gh` could also do this.

### Proposed solution

The underlying `survey` library offers a [`Suggest` option](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/AlecAivazis/survey/v2@v2.3.2#readme-suggestion-options) which gives a callback to provide a list of options on `tab` (see below). This callback can hit the `search` API endpoint to retrieve suggestions to display to the user. 

As an additional enhancement, `gh` could cache some recently used repos - either used with `cs` or really any repos the user interacts with - to include with (or use instead of) the `search` results.

![suggestions](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5447118/150895591-0b0bc326-e625-42b9-a468-01990cd8319a.gif)

### Additional context

The example above hits `/search/repositories?q=react+in:name`. If the user enters a full owner name and partial repo name (e.g. `facebook/re`) we can instead hit `/search/repositories?q=re+user:facebook+in:name` which gives much better results from what I've seen. Additionally, searching with the full owner name also will return private repos which is useful.
comments: This seems like a great feature; we'll want to be mindful of performance or just limit the number of queries we fetch. If you'd like to turn your proof-of-concept into a more formal PR, we'd happily help get it over the finish line.

review_comments: Nitpick: there doesn't seem to be much value added by this function, so I would suggest that this get inlined at call point

The reason I pulled it out into a separate method is for later improvements with some ideas I left in the source issue (#5093) such as including repos that have recently been used by the cli - e.g. repos the user commonly creates codespaces for. This method allows us to build up that more complicated logic in this method rather than inlined in the Survey config. That said, it's easy to pull it back out into a method later also so I'm OK to inline it.
Actually I take that back - now that it the `per_page` and `sort` params are refactored out, the method is a little bit big for inlining
